decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer builds directly on the firm's core inkjet and ink expertise, so in-house R&D can read its early market results and keep improving it within the established portfolio.

The numbering software module extends the firm's existing software portfolio for inline printing of variable data and fits its strategic direction toward serialization and traceability, at low cost to maintain.

The inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces draws on the firm's deep ink chemistry and coding know-how and serves customers needing marking on varied surfaces, so the firm can assimilate feedback and refine it.
